correctness.rationale: The square-zero equation is equivalent to N^2=0 and independent anti-commutator equations. A fixed residue rank r yields q^{2dr(n-r)} free lift entries and a completely free ds-by-s matrix K. An exact kernel calculation on R^n identifies full field rank as (d+1)r+rank(K). The count of rank-t K is a product of Gaussian coefficients and GL_t(q), establishing all fibers. Independent direct enumeration verifies six complete small examples including an actual rank gap. Finite experiments support but do not establish the all-field theorem.

broader_coverage.reasoning: A theorem for square-free or irreducible reduction P cannot imply its repeated-root specialization P=t² by direct substitution. An identification of a representation scheme with X²=0 also does not calculate its point strata by homology rank over a nonreduced coefficient algebra. There may be a different, uninspected broader lift-count theorem; that is reported as residual risk.

value.rationale: The homology dimension of a one-periodic finite free differential is a canonical homological invariant, rather than an arbitrary slice. The exact all-parameter joint enumerator records information lost by the residue-rank census, yields sharp homology minima and exactness/nonexactness thresholds, and exhibits noncontiguous rank spectra in rank-two free modules for embedding dimension at least three. These classifications can be used to distinguish finite free-complex behaviors over square-zero local algebras.
